title: Bounded-above finite-free Hom computes derived internal Hom into a bounded-below complex
statement: For a ringed space U, bounded-above finite-free complex E and bounded-below complex G of module sheaves, the localized sheaf Hom complex Q(homComplex E G) is isomorphic to derived internal Hom(Q E, Q G).

proof.text: Choose M from hGbounded, convert it to G.IsStrictlyGE M with isStrictlyGE_iff, and apply exists_boundedBelow_injective_resolution to obtain i:G→I, QuasiIso i, a lower bound N for I, and I.IsKInjective.
The cone of i is acyclic by quasiIso_iff_acyclic. Its degree q terms are G^(q+1) and I^q, so min(M−1,N) bounds it below, using mappingCone.isZero_X_iff.

Apply acyclic_homComplex_of_boundedAbove_finiteFree to E and cone(i). Transport exactness in each degree across homComplex_mappingCone_iso. The acyclic-cone criterion gives QuasiIso for the Hom map, and DerivedCategory.Q.map inverts it.
Apply derivedInternalHom_obj_iso to E and the K-injective I, using the inverse of Q(i) as the representative isomorphism Q(I)≅Q(G). Compose its inverse with the isomorphism Q(Hom(E,G))≅Q(Hom(E,I)).

proof_origin.place: Section 08J7, K-injective representative computation, combined with the bounded acyclic Hom lemma and the explicit cone comparison; formalized by U2.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedInternalHom_of_boundedAbove_finiteFree_aux
    (U : RingedSpace.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U))]
    (E G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U)) ℤ)
    (hEbounded : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, N < p → IsZero (E.X p))
    (hEfree : ∀ p : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X p ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hGbounded : ∃ M : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < M → IsZero (G.X q)) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CategoryTheory.homComplex (R := U.sheaf) E G) ≅
      (CategoryTheory.derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) U.sheaf).obj
        (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj E), DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))
